title.narrative: Transformative Growth of the Care Economy in Türkiye

description.narrative: Under the coordination of the UN Resident Coordinator, the ILO will lead the UN Joint Programme (UNJP) and implement it in collaboration with UNDP. The implementing agencies will cooperate with UN Women, UNICEF, and UNFPA. The Joint Program has two interlink outputs:1. Development of care economy and service provision models ready-for-implementation and endorsed by central and local actors, including those harnessing the potentials of digital transformation (Implemented by UNDP)2. Increased capacity among the government institutions and social partners to develop, implement and monitor a road map on improvement of policies and financing strategy of care economy in Türkiye. (Implemented by ILO)

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
